rationale: The agent verified identity via matching email before accessing account data. It located the correct order containing the bookshelf, confirmed the intended change first, checked product availability with read-only tools, and correctly reported that the 4-foot glass/white variant was unavailable. Upon the user’s request to cancel, the agent explicitly requested confirmation with the stated reason before performing any write. The cancellation was applied to the correct pending order (#W8835847), which is eligible for cancellation, and the tool result confirms the refund to the gift card. The agent’s final message accurately reflects the tool results (status cancelled, full refund amount, refund destination) and did not fabricate information. No unauthorized actions or policy violations are evident.
